items.a: **Nothing**: it **leveraged TV** to sell **other people's products**.

items.q: What do QVC hosts say is the magic of selling?
items.a: **Authenticity** and **selling a story**; people **forget features but remember stories**.

items.q: Why does a QVC host never sell alone?
items.a: A **producer in the ear** plus **live sales data** guide the pitch in real time.

items.q: What are Simon's three steps to sell anything?
items.a: **Tell your story**, describe the **product honestly**, then **close** with a reason to buy now.

items.q: How did the QVC host make buyers picture the product?
items.a: She described **real moments of use**: 'on the way to the gym, on the way to work'.

items.q: Why did 303,000 impressions bring zero sales?
items.a: No one **closed** and there was **no reason to buy now**.

items.q: What should a solo live seller watch?
items.a: A **live dashboard**, so after **five minutes** without sales you **change approach**.

items.q: How can you start a business with no product or money?
items.a: **Affiliate-sell** something you **genuinely use** and earn a cut of every sale.

items.q: Why keep going live daily even with small results?
items.a: Each live **compounds**: one day brought **260 new customers** to learn from.
